entries.back_en: Every so often, a bunch of strange people come in here. They don't say who they are or why they're here... We're just guards, so they never tell us what's going on.
I had told you from the beginning that this was my intention.
entries.note: Archaic 'vos' fits Fou-Lu's register; meaning intact.

entries.back_en: Besides, I believe [04][04] has also understood that even if the Empire manages to imprison [04]
entries.note: 'get a hold of' rendered as 'aprisionar' (imprison); likely means capture/obtain — narrows sense.

entries.back_en: Hmm... I have the feeling I've seen that winged girl somewhere before...
Hm? Lord Yuna? He had returned from the capital by now, but with all that's happening, he may be stuck somewhere.
entries.note: 'was scheduled to have returned' became 'tinha voltado' (had returned); loses the 'supposed to/deveria ter voltado' nuance.

entries.back_en: I shouldn't talk this way, but Lord Yuna really gives me the creeps. I mean, he's always doing weird rituals and stuff.
entries.note: Idiom 'gives me the creeps' well rendered.
